import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
# correlation among exposures
print(df[exposures].corr().round(2))
print()
# hdl by hospital
print(df.groupby('hospital')['hdl'].mean())
print(df.groupby('hospital')['recovery_score'].mean())
# hdl effect with and without hospital
d = df.dropna(subset=['hdl','recovery_score'])
print(smf.ols('recovery_score ~ hdl', data=d).fit().params['hdl'], smf.ols('recovery_score ~ hdl', data=d).fit().pvalues['hdl'])
# add quadratic
d2 = d.copy(); d2['hdl2']=d2['hdl']**2
print(smf.ols('recovery_score ~ hdl + hdl2 + C(hospital)', data=d2).fit().pvalues[['hdl','hdl2']])
